column1: # meanings.tsv — AI-written modern meanings: the dictionary layer for words that the
# Praharaj dictionary (1931–40) does not have, or explains with an old or wrong sense
# for modern text (verb forms, compounds, prefixed words, names, function words).
# Written by Claude (Anthropic) in sessions for this project, from its own knowledge
# of Odia; not copied from any dictionary. Corpus sentences were read only to pick the
# words and their sense in use; none is stored here. Licence: MIT (this project).
# Shown after the owner's meanings (glosses.tsv) and before the modern [mt] layer and
# Praharaj (decision D-13). Every surface labels status "ai" as AI-written and not yet
# Format: odia <TAB> meaning <TAB> senses <TAB> formation <TAB> origin <TAB> status <TAB> note
#   odia       a word; two words "a b"; or a construction "-suffix word" (the word after
#              a word that ends in the suffix: "-କୁ ନେଇ" is ନେଇ after ...କୁ). Canonical.
#   meaning    one short line (at most 56 characters), the chip and the lens card
#   senses     all senses, ";"-separated, the modern one first
#   formation  how the word is made, in Odia with English glosses (may be empty)
#   origin     native | sanskrit | persian | arabic | english | hindi | portuguese |
#   status     ai (not yet checked) | owner (checked by the owner) | wrong (never shown)
# Checked by core/src/curation.ts parseMeanings (strict: canonical Odia, no duplicates,
# English columns without Odia). Coverage: npx tsx tools/eval/meanings-coverage.ts
